name: dsh-vscode
description: Run the DeepSeek Harness agent inside VS Code. The extension manages a local dsh runtime and answers as the @dsh chat participant over the project you have open.

chatParticipants.name: dsh
chatParticipants.description: Ask the DeepSeek Harness agent about the project you have open

dsh.runtime.command.markdownDescription: Executable used to launch the runtime. Defaults to `dsh` (must be on PATH). `${workspaceFolder}` is expanded to the first workspace folder. When developing inside the deepseek-harness monorepo, set this to `node` and use `#dsh.runtime.args#` to point at the workspace CLI.

dsh.runtime.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `#dsh.runtime.command#`. Must launch a runtime that serves the Harness SDK protocol on stdio — the `editor` profile does. Each flag and value should be its own array item (`["--import", "tsx/esm", "…/bin.ts", "--profile", "editor"]`). A single item that starts with `-` and contains spaces is split. `${workspaceFolder}` is expanded in each argument.

dsh.runtime.autoStart.description: Start the runtime when the extension activates instead of waiting for the first chat request.

dsh.runtime.cwd.markdownDescription: Working directory for the runtime process, which is also the workspace its file tools and sandbox policy resolve against. Empty uses the first open workspace folder. `${workspaceFolder}` is expanded.

dsh.runtime.handshakeTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait for the runtime to answer the SDK `initialize` handshake before reporting a start failure. Increase this for a slow source (`tsx`) launch.

dsh.runtime.env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the runtime process, for example `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` or `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`. The runtime also reads the credentials it manages under `$DSH_HOME` and a project `.env`.

dsh.model.provider.markdownDescription: Provider route every session runs on, sent as `initialize.provider`. The runtime must have an adapter registered for it.

dsh.model.name.markdownDescription: Model every session runs on, sent as `initialize.model`.
